## Mobile report queue
Connect app report RPCs and select the server-only Header Auth credential on the Supabase nodes. Set the DoorLoop child workflow ID. Use Poll Once with a queued request before publishing. Publishing starts the queue poll. Daily collection is controlled in Supabase.
